svg.text: CHG carrier r7 (round 4): outline, tabs, feet, tap field

Top view, Eagle .brd board coordinates in mm (+y up), 8 px/mm. Sources: r7_calc_out.json H.23 (a), (d), (g), (h), (i), (l), (m); design A.7/A.8; MB parts and layer-1 copper from the .brd (mb_neighbours.py via r7_calc.py).

Drawn on the CR top side: outlines, header pads, W1-W4 holes, W6/W7 pads, tap pads, R175 pads, J101 and comparator regions, the W-lead dressing path, beads B1/B3 and W5 spacers S1-S3 (calc revision 4).
Drawn under the CR or on the MB: MB parts, MB copper, feet (CR bottom), polyimide sheet with relief holes and cut-outs, polyimide strip, tie bases A1/A2.
EVM reference placement past the MB +y edge
(BASIS D7, H.23(l)), same board coordinates, 2.4 px/mm
Adopted once MS2 confirms the chassis room; plate and clamps
Ticks on the MB +y edge: x 58.00 (W1, W2, W6, W7), 74.75 (W5), 77.25 (W3, W4).
Chassis tie past that edge <= 4.4 / 19.4 / 18.4 mm (A.3 anchor rule).
Fallbacks if MS2 rejects this placement (H.23(l)):
(i) EVM + EIB shifted -x 27.03 mm (orange dashed, clipped): PASSES;
needs 45.3 mm of chassis room past the MB -x edge (W1 at x -34.83
+ 10.5 mm bend; EVM overhang 27.4 mm), clear of J-BL/J-FC/J-NTC (MS2).
(ii) EIB past the USB corridor: FAILS (W3/W4/W5 blocked; E maxima > D7).
(iii) EIB at the EVM left edge: FAILS (E4 82.3 mm > 59 mm limit).
r7 outline (solid): r6 rectangle + tab X + tab Y
r7 polyimide sheet (dotted), on the MB
foot body (CR bottom); keep-out, FT1 lane dashed
FT2 1.0 mm fill hole (NPTH); 2.0 mm keep-out
thermal band (6.4 mm from the 5V rim)
MB part near the tabs (bold label)
R175 pad: a Teensy 3V3 (F07) side, b rail side
W-lead path: centre line, band = jacket envelope
W5 ribbon: centre line, 8.89 mm band
3-D rule: span held above the MB on spacers
RTV bead / spacer post B1, B3 (3 x 3 mm)
W5 spacer bead S1-S3 (3 x 3 mm)
MB tie base A1/A2; dashed: +-1.5 mm zone
polyimide strip on the MB (envelope + 2 mm)

Tap field (calc revision 4, D-F4 adjacency exclusions): 20 pads + R175 on tab X in a 6 x 4 grid at 2.54 mm (x 50.80-63.50, y 58.94-66.56; H.23(g)); R175 pads R175a (50.80, 64.02) and R175b (50.80, 61.48); spares (53.34, 61.48) and (53.34, 66.56) (sp).
Pad number = F-number; the tap of each F-pad is in A.4. Every orthogonal pair is in the H.23(g) short table; none is forbidden.

Residual tap pads on the footprint low-y band (H.23(g)): F08 (T22) at (26.44, 35.80), F09 (T8) at (28.98, 35.80), F10 (T9) at (31.52, 35.80), F22 (T18) at (41.68, 35.80); F22 is the low-row T18 position nearest CO-5V (BASIS B3; straight 10.54 mm to CO-5V pad 1).

FT1 = 4.0 x 1.6 mm at (61.72, 66.71), tx/ty ±0.304/0.294 mm, bound by the MPPT-DISABLE L1 trace (1.0 mm); FT2 = 4.0 x 4.0 mm at (28.00, 73.25), tx/ty ±7.060/0.250 mm, bound by the r7 outline edge (0.5 mm) (H.23(i)).
Foot block height h_f = 2.54 - t_bed 0.30 - t_bond 0.05 = 2.19 mm (block +0/-0.05 mm; 0.05 mm acrylic transfer tape on the CR bottom; H.23(i)).
Foot keep-out = body + 0.5 mm; FT1 has an RTV lane to the tab X top edge (bedded before the W leads and taps, B1), FT2 has no lane (H.23(d)).
FT2 sits at the far edge of tab Y (B2: largest lever from the pin-11 row with t >= 0.25 mm); its +y lane is behind the L-FC body, so it is bedded through a 1.0 mm NPTH fill hole at (28.00, 73.25),
injected from the CR top (2.0 mm CR-top keep-out disc). The mid-height spot (28.00, 71.32), ty 2.18 mm, is a sensitivity case only.
Thermal band boundary: H.23(h) samples at x 48.7-64.7 (1 mm) plus x 65.00 (y 60.32), computed here with r7_calc.d5v under the same rule.
Copper rim = polygon vertex path or trace centre line + half the outline width (r7_calc convention); vias at the 0.7564 mm pad. Only the 5V set near tab X and the VBUS pour near tab X are drawn.
W6/W7 pads: A.8 gives 1.2 x 1.5 mm; the orientation (1.2 mm along x) is an ASSUMPTION. Header pads are drawn at the A.8 minimum 1.9 mm.

W-lead dressing path (A.3, H.23(l)): trunk +y on x 25.80, +x across tab Y at y 69.60-71.75, off the CR at x 37.56 to tie base A1; west group (W1, W2, W6, W7) up x 58.00, east group (W3, W4, W5) via A2.

Anchors: beads B1/B3 and W5 spacers S1-S3 on the CR (3.0 x 3.0 mm, ASSUMPTION; B3 and S3 merge), tie bases A1 6 x 6 mm +- 1.5 and A2 10 x 10 mm +- 1.5 on the MB (zone dashed); longest span 26.0 mm (<= 30 mm).
3-D switched-conductor rule (decision 2026-11-10, no height limit): the round leads are held >= 14.41 mm above the MB from B1 to (50.45, 72.09), W5 >= 15.00 mm (L-FC top 5.0 mm, ASSUMPTION).
Polyimide strip on the MB under the leads off the CR: lead envelope + 2.0 mm within x 36.06-65.28, y 65.30-92.80 (drawn from the tab Y +x edge); it stops at each tie-base footprint.

W1/W2: fixed build length 0.30 m +- 10 mm (routes 199.5 / 202.2 mm; slack = service loop on the EVM plate, D-F3). Route maxima after MS2: W3 200, W4 200, W6 140, W7 SCL 160, W7 SDA 160 mm; until MS2 the 0.30 m caps stay the T-A-02 bound.
W5: fixed 304.8 mm factory cable; route 202.7 mm + 20 mm 3-D allowance = 222.7 mm minimum fit.
Sheet openings (H.23(m)): 2.2 mm relief holes at the 22 header pads (3.4 mm holes would merge into slots and drop t_bed to 0.175 mm); five enlarged cut-outs merge into two openings.

EVM panel: EVM, EIB, USB corridor and routes from H.23(l); the EVM bottom edge sits 20 mm past the MB +y edge (J8 mating gap); J1/J5/J7/J8 dots are the route terminals; the USB plug + bend length is TODO(measure: MS2).

MB parts within 25 mm of the r7 outline that lie wholly below y 25 (outside the window): C-D3, C-D4, C-DC3, C1-BT, C3-BT, C5-BT, C6-BT, CC-BT, D-BT-EN, J-BT, L-BT, OP-BT, R1-BT, R2-BT, RC-BT, RD1-BT, RD2-BT, REG-BT, RINJ-BT, ROP1-BT, ROP2-BT.
